lessons.title: Close-up: shoes, couch leg and cap

zoom.label: The woman's feet, at the left end of the couch

c1.text: Level one: some details are lost. Now zoom to her feet at the end of the couch.

zoom.label: The woman's feet, at the left end of the couch

sources.title: Musée du Louvre, collection record Cp 5194.2, 'Sarcophage des époux' (the lid; our translations)
[S. Birch and C. T. Newton], Report on the Campana Collection (London, 1856)
Cataloghi del Museo Campana (Rome, 1850s), Classe I (our translation)

correction.tempting: Bare toes show just behind her feet.
correction.truth: Her own feet wear pointed shoes whose tips once turned up.
correction.evidence: The Louvre record; Report on the Campana Collection (1856); Campana's catalogue.

c1b.text: Yes. She wears pointed shoes whose tips turned up. The curled tips have broken off.

correction.truth: The lines are laces: she wears closed, laced shoes with pointed toes.
correction.evidence: Report on the Campana Collection (1856); Campana's catalogue.

c1m.text: Pointed shoes, their curled tips lost.

zoom.label: One leg of the couch, at the right end of the chest

c2.text: Level one: the couch forms a chest. Now zoom to one of its legs.

zoom.label: One leg of the couch, at the right end of the chest

c2q.text: What tops this leg of the couch?

sources.title: Musée du Louvre, collection record Cp 5194.1, 'Sarcophage des époux' (the chest; our translations)
[S. Birch and C. T. Newton], Report on the Campana Collection (London, 1856)
Cataloghi del Museo Campana (Rome, 1850s), Classe I (our translation)

c2a.text: No paw: scrolls top the leg.

correction.tempting: Furniture legs often end in animal feet.
correction.truth: The leg is topped by a double scroll, a volute like an Ionic capital.
correction.evidence: The Louvre record; Report on the Campana Collection (1856).

c2b.text: Yes. A double scroll, or volute, tops each leg. The 1850s writers compared it to an Ionic capital.

correction.tempting: The couple's faces are just above.
correction.truth: The leg is topped by a double volute, compared to an Ionic capital.

c2m.text: A couch leg with an Ionic scroll.

c3.text: Level one: the couple recline together. Now zoom to her head.

sources.title: Musée du Louvre, collection record Cp 5194.2, 'Sarcophage des époux' (the lid; our translations)
[S. Birch and C. T. Newton], Report on the Campana Collection (London, 1856)

c3a.text: Not a helmet: a soft cap.

correction.truth: She wears a close cap, with long tresses falling from beneath it.
correction.evidence: The Louvre record; Report on the Campana Collection (1856).

c3b.text: Her hair falls in tresses, below a cap.

correction.tempting: Its rounded shape looks like a hairstyle.
correction.truth: She wears a cap; her hair falls from under it in long tresses.
correction.evidence: The Louvre record; Report on the Campana Collection (1856).

c3c.text: Yes. She wears a close cap, and her long hair falls from beneath it in tresses, two of them hanging in front.

c3m.text: A cap, and long tresses below it.
